automation.title: Settings
automation.help: Manage connections, processes and schedules. Orders always need your confirmation; new recurring schedules are disabled.
automation.connectionHelp: Status of supported services. Keys and other secrets are managed outside the application.
automation.unsupportedConnections: Reddit and StockTwits do not yet have data connectors. A healthy connection does not establish data completeness.
automation.rolesHelp: Analyses use configured LiteLLM roles. Model and credential changes are managed in server configuration.
automation.pauseHelp: Global pause stops new automatic starts. Work already running can finish; explicit manual starts remain available.
automation.windowHelp: Empty bounds allow the entire day. Overnight windows belong to their start day. Missing DST times are skipped; repeated times run once.
automation.conflict: Settings changed while you were editing. Your draft is preserved; load the latest revision before saving again.
automation.invalidPolicy: Could not save. Check the time zone, weekdays, interval and both window bounds.
automation.outsideWindow: Explicitly run outside the allowed window
automation.runError: Could not start. Check the current revision, enabled process and allowed window.
automation.queued: The start is recorded durably. The queue will pick it up when available.
automation.requestError: Data is unavailable. Your input is preserved; try again.
automation.batchHelp: Preview uses current positions or the watchlist. Acceptance checks active analyses and the shared daily quota again.
automation.emptyBatch: There are no instruments in this scope.
automation.noExecutions: There are no recorded process executions yet.

executionReasons.superseded: Superseded by the latest due occurrence

automation.enableBatch: Enable the recurring analysis batch process in Settings before acceptance. The Manual only schedule keeps automatic starts disabled.
